operationSets.name: ProblemActions
operationSets.comment:
A problem's wake-ups and status operations (D104), for any signed-in
caller: the core decides who may set a wake-up (problems.schedule) and when
it runs.

operations.name: schedulesSetSchedule
operations.comment: Sets a schedule of the row by its name: exactly one of after, every and cron, of a kind the config's kinds take, within minMs and maxMs, a cron line read in timeZone. A live schedule of the name is replaced and its runs start again; one with the same kind, spec and time zone is answered unchanged. A new name needs room under max, and a row in a state endOn names takes none.

docs.title: Problem schedules: set schedule
docs.description: Sets a schedule of the row by its name: exactly one of after, every and cron, of a kind the config's kinds take, within minMs and maxMs, a cron line read in timeZone. A live schedule of the name is replaced and its runs start again; one with the same kind, spec and time zone is answered unchanged. A new name needs room under max, and a row in a state endOn names takes none.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: schedulesPauseSchedule
operations.comment: Pauses an active schedule: it keeps its next run and the retry of its latest one, and its deadline is cleared until it resumes. A paused one is answered unchanged.

docs.title: Problem schedules: pause schedule
docs.description: Pauses an active schedule: it keeps its next run and the retry of its latest one, and its deadline is cleared until it resumes. A paused one is answered unchanged.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: schedulesResumeSchedule
operations.comment: Resumes a paused schedule, arming its next run, or the retry of its latest, again: one past its time falls due at once and fires once. An active one is answered unchanged; a row in a state endOn names resumes none.

docs.title: Problem schedules: resume schedule
docs.description: Resumes a paused schedule, arming its next run, or the retry of its latest, again: one past its time falls due at once and fires once. An active one is answered unchanged; a row in a state endOn names resumes none.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: schedulesCancelSchedule
operations.comment: Finishes a live schedule, clearing its deadline, so it no longer counts toward max; it stays, finished, for its latest run's report and a read. A finished one is answered unchanged.

docs.title: Problem schedules: cancel schedule
docs.description: Finishes a live schedule, clearing its deadline, so it no longer counts toward max; it stays, finished, for its latest run's report and a read. A finished one is answered unchanged.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: schedulesReportRun
operations.comment: Records the outcome of a schedule's latest run, one of the config's outcomes. The config's retry outcome tries the run again afterMs on, as its next attempt, unless the next regular run comes first; another outcome cancels a retry armed for it. A report of an older run, of a replaced schedule's latest run, or of an attempt other than the latest, or a repeat of the outcome recorded, is answered unchanged.

docs.title: Problem schedules: report run
docs.description: Records the outcome of a schedule's latest run, one of the config's outcomes. The config's retry outcome tries the run again afterMs on, as its next attempt, unless the next regular run comes first; another outcome cancels a retry armed for it. A report of an older run, of a replaced schedule's latest run, or of an attempt other than the latest, or a repeat of the outcome recorded, is answered unchanged.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.name: schedulesListSchedules
operations.comment: Lists the row's schedules by name in code point order, live and finished; with name, only that one.

docs.title: Problem schedules: list schedules
docs.description: Lists the row's schedules by name in code point order, live and finished; with name, only that one.

arguments.name: id
arguments.comment: The key of the Problem row the operation runs on.

operations.comment: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

docs.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

arguments.name: id

workers.name: ProblemWakeUps
workers.comment:
Runs Problem's wake-ups as they fall due, the writes of its rows its
Schedules hears, and the events its wake-ups emit, each handed to the
project's Workers method problemWakeUpsSchedulesRun (D104). The worker
fixture-schedules-api-problem-wake-ups.

events.description: A run of a schedule fell due and fired: its name, which run and which attempt of it, its kind and spec, the time zone of a cron line, when the schedule was set, when the run was due and when it fired, and the schedule's next regular run when it has one. Delivery is at least once, so a handler is idempotent by the row's key, the name, setAt, the run and the attempt, which no two fires share, and reports the run's outcome with reportRun, naming the run and the attempt.
